verdict.rationale: Motion documents a public REST API with a full endpoint reference, cookbooks, and availability for all users, covering creating, updating, and managing projects and tasks. A runtime probe confirmed the API is live and enforces its documented X-API-Key auth. Missing for 10: evidence that the API covers calendar/scheduling and meeting operations beyond projects and tasks, and independent community corroboration of real-world API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
